items.t: Trump says he ‘would not mind’ if Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO
items.d: President Donald Trump said he “wouldn’t mind” Jensen Huang being reinstated as CEO of NVIDIA after he was ousted.
items.fullText: Trump administration Trump says he ‘would not mind’ if Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO The president said he did not know if Alice Huang, the suspected Chinese intelligence asset with whom Jensen Huang had a relationship, was actually a spy. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Trump 'would not mind' having Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO 01:02 Get more news Live on Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 16, 2026, 9:50 AM EST / Updated Nov. 16, 2026, 9:58 AM EST By Megan Brand and Rob Wile President Donald Trump told reporters Monday that he “would not mind” if Jensen Huang were reinstated as CEO of Nvidia after he was ousted following allegations of multiple extramarital relationships, including one with a woman determined to be a Chinese intelligence asset. “I would not mind that,” the president said when asked about a reinstatement, adding that he thinks the ex-Nvidia chief, who resigned last week after the allegations were reported, had “learned a big lesson.” After Huang stepped down, Trump said he would support former Apple CEO Tim Cook as Huang’s successor at Nvidia, which he noted again in comments to White House reporters Monday. The president also told reporters that he did not know if Alice Huang was actually a spy, despite a U.S. intelligence assessment that she was working for Beijing. “I don’t know that she is a spy,” Trump said as he prepared to leave for his Asia trip. Huang’s departure from Nvidia marked a major shakeup that sent ripples through the stock market and raised questions about technology sector vulnerabilities to Chinese espionage operations, which could have national security implications. Nvidia has hired an outside law firm to investigate the allegations against Huang, whose relationships may have violated company policies and who presided over export arrangements that raised concerns about Nvidia chips reaching China. Asked by a reporter what he would say to Americans who are concerned that national security was put at risk because of his close relationship with Jensen Huang and the business leader’s alleged affair with a suspected spy, Trump said that national security “was not put at risk.” Two senior U.S. officials previously told reporters they did not believe Trump would raise the Alice Huang espionage investigation with Xi. One of the officials said Nvidia “should not really have any bearing on the trip.” President Donald Trump and former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Bloomberg via Getty Asked Monday why he was not planning to confront Xi about the alleged spying on Nvidia, Trump replied, “I may.” Trump’s openness to the possibility of Huang’s return to Nvidia comes as an online petition supporting the idea has garnered about 180,000 signatures. Some high profile Silicon Valley personalities, including Elon Musk and former Uber CEO Travis Kalanick, said they backed the effort to restore Huang. items.d: 인공지능(AI) 기업 앤스로픽의 최고경영자(CEO) 다리오 아모데이가 AI 속도 조절론이란 화두를 던진 게 9월이었다. 오픈AI의 샘 올트먼도 공개적으로 “동의한다”고 했다. 구글의 데미스 허사비스와 스페이스X AI의 일론 머스크 역시 “다리오가 맞다”며 힘을 보탰다. 당시 반응은 여러 갈래로 나뉘었다. 고성능 AI 에이전트의 위험천만한 일탈에 충격을 받은 이들은 AI 기업들의 멈출 수 있는 용기에 지지를 보냈다. 반면 이익 독식을 위해 제멋대로 ‘고’와 ‘스톱’을 정하려는 ‘선두권 야합’이라는 비판도 나왔다. 신중론을 꺼내고 맞장구를 친 기업 네 곳을 상대로는 반독점 소송까지 제기됐다.치명상 입은 트럼프와 젠슨 황 하지만 이런 찬반을 떠나 가장 설득력이 있었던 주장은 따로 있었다. 과연 실현 가능한 제안이

items.t: 젠슨 황 퇴진 3일만에 '복귀 작전'…베선트 재무는 '제동'
items.fullText: 글로벌 시장 브리핑 젠슨 황 퇴진 3일만에 '복귀 작전'…베선트 재무는 '제동' 입력 2026.11.16 21:02 수정 2026.11.16 23:05 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 김정아 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. AI 기사요약 실리콘밸리 일각의 젠슨 황 전 CEO 복귀 추진 움직임에도 불구하고, 미국 재무장관이 대중국 AI 칩 수출 통제 우회 의혹을 제기하며 외부 인사를 통한 엔비디아의 전면적인 경영진 개편을 강력히 요구하고 있습니다. 베선트, 엔비디아, 대중 첨단칩 불법판매 여부 답변해야" 물레나르 의원 "모든 중국인은 간첩행위 강요받을 수 있음을 몰랐다면 무책임" 사진=REUTERS 포스트 젠슨 황 CEO를 찾으라는 압박이 거센 가운데 실리콘 밸리 테크계에서 젠슨 황 복귀를 추진하고 젠슨황 측근들도 복귀 작전에 나서고 있다. 그러나 스콧 베선트 미국 재무장관은 엔비디아가 중국에 대한 첨단 AI칩의 판매를 방관했을 가능성과 수출통제 준수여부를 공개하라며 외부 CEO 등 ‘획기적’인 경영진 개편을 요구했다. 16일(현지시간) 파이낸셜 타임스와 블룸버그 등에 따르면, 젠슨 황은 30여 년 전 자신이 공동 창업한 엔비디아로 복귀하는 방안을 논의중이며, 실리콘 밸리의 일부 지자자들이 그의 복귀를 위한 ‘작전실’(war room)을 구성하고 있다고 보도했다. 엔비디아 주가는 지난주 12.7% 하락하면서 2025년 4월 이후 최악의 한 주를 보냈다. 한경 프리미엄9의 모든 콘텐츠는 한국경제신문의 저작물로 저작권법의 보호를 받습니다. 사전 허가 없는 무단 전재·복제·배포·캡처 공유·AI 학습 활용 및 상업적 이용을 금합니다. 위반 시 서비스 이용 제한 및 민형사상 법적 책임이 발생할 수 있습니다. 무료 열람 혜택으로 기사를 읽으셨습니다. 한경 프리미엄9을 구독하고 무제한으로 만나보세요. 구독하기 AI 뉴스 Q&A 더 궁금한 점이 있으신가요? 읽으면서 머릿속에 맴돌던 질문들, 앨리스가 대답해 드릴게요. 인공지능(AI)을 활용해 생성되었으며, 일부 내용에 오류가 있을 수 있습니다. AI 포인트 뷰 이전 분석 종목 다음 분석 종목 본 서비스의 AI가 제공하는 종목 정보는 정보 제공 목적의 참고 자료일 뿐, 투자 권유·자문·추천에 해당하지 않습니다. 투자에 따른 손실 책임은 사용자에게 있습니다. 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 김정아 객원기자 기자로 14년, 자본시장에서 18년 일했습니다. 글로벌 기업과 자본시장을 주시하고 있습니다. 기사댓글 개의 댓글이 있습니다. 댓글 닫기

"젠슨 황, 오만하고 위선적"…전기 작가의 폭로 사진=로이터 젠슨 황 전 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)의 전기를 집필한 작가 스티븐 윗이 황 전 CEO의 겸손한 대외 이미지와 실제 리더십 사이에 괴리가 있었다고 주장했다. 스티븐 윗은 15일(현지시간) 뉴욕타임스(NYT)에 황 전 CEO가 오만하고 위선적인 인물이며, 정치 때문에 몰락했다는 취지의 기고문을 보냈다. 사생활 의혹 속에 물러난 황 전 CEO의 몰락에는 미국 행정부 내부의 대중국 정책 갈등도 작용했다는 분석도 내놓았다. 윗은 2023년 황 전 CEO와 처음 만났다며 "그는 겸손한 사람이라는 이미지를 밀고 있었다"며 "공로는 임직원에게 돌리고, 서비스업 종사자들에게 친근하게 대하며, 작고 허름한 식당을 찾아가 과한 팁을 남기는 것을 좋아했다"고 돌이켰다. 사진=REUTERS 미국 대중음식점 체인 데니스에서 아침 식사를 한 뒤 1000달러를 팁으로 남긴 일도 언급했다. 윗은 "시간이 흐르면서 이것들이 연기라는 의심이 들었다"며 "남들을 위한 연기가 아니라 자기 자신을 기쁘게 하려는 연기였다"고 평가했다. 가족에 대한 애정 표현도 비판적으로 돌아봤다. 윗은 "늘 아내와 자녀에 대해 이야기했고 이 애정은 진짜처럼 보였다"면서도 "여기서는 연기를 알아채기가 더 어려웠다. 상당한 자기기만이 있었을 것"이라고 주장했다. 조직 내부에서는 다른 모습을 보였다는 게 윗의 설명이다. 그는 "그는 이견을 참지 못했다. 1시간 넘게 직원을 질책하기도 했고 임원진이 그를 두려워했다"고 전했다. 여성 인력에 대한 엔비디아의 태도 변화도 거론했다. 1990년대에는 여성 직원이 거의 없었고 가슴을 강조한 요정을 마스코트로 사용했지만, 2020년에는 여성의 역량 강화와 성별 균형을 강조하기 시작했다고 지적했다. 윗은 황 전 CEO와 트럼프 대통령의 관계에도 주목했다. 그는 "2025년 황 전 CEO가 트럼프 대통령의 측근이 됐을 때 놀랐다"며 "교묘한 사교술을 통해, 특히 아첨으로 대통령의 신뢰를 얻었다"고 주장했다. 두 사람이 허세와 자기애 등의 성향을 공유한다고 평가하면서 여성 편력에 관한 추측도 덧붙였다. 황 전 CEO가 물러나게 된 배경으로는 정치적 충돌을 지목했다. 황 전 CEO가 트럼프 대통령을 설득해 엔비디아 반도체의 중국 수출 제한을 완화하는 과정에서 행정부 내 대중 강경파와 갈등을 빚었다는 것이다. 윗은 황 전 CEO에 대한 폭로 메모를 주도한 인물로 마코 루비오 국무장관을 지목했다. 엔비디아의 후계 구도에도 우려를 나타냈다. 윗은 "젠슨 황이 없는 엔비디아는 마이클 조던이 없는 시카고 불스와 같다"며 "황 전 CEO는 맨바닥에서 엔비디아를 일궜지만, 그의 오만함 때문에 채울 수 없는 공백을 남기게 됐다"고 말했다. 한편 홍콩01 등 중화권 매체들은 비즈니스 정보업체 화얼제젠원을 인용해 앤트로픽의 다리오 아모데이 CEO가 이번 사건의 제보자일 수 있다는 온라인 소문도 전했다. 오픈소스 AI 모델을 옹호해 온 황 전 CEO와 AI 규제 및 반도체 수출 통제를 지지하는 아모데이 CEO의 입장 차이를 근거로 제시한 것이다. 이는 사회관계망서비스(SNS)에서 제기된 추측이지만 빠르게 확산되는 모습이다. 김소연 한경닷컴 기자 sue123@hankyung.com 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 ⓒ 한경닷컴, 무단전재 및 재배포 금지 한국경제 구독신청 한경 프리미엄9 구독신청 김소연 기자 한경닷컴 김소연 기자는 패션, 뷰티, F&B, 플랫폼 등 '유통' 산업 전반을 취재하는 기자입니다. 대학에서 미디어와 콘텐츠 산업을 전공하고 2012년부터 현장을 누벼온 베테랑 취재 기자로, 엔터 산업의 흐름을 다룬 기명 기획 시리즈 '김소연의 엔터비즈'를 연재하며 차별화된 입지를 구축했습니다. 독자의 일상과 밀접하게 호흡하는 생활밀착형 저널리즘을 바탕으로 2018년부터 매년 '한경닷컴 우수기자상'을 연속 수상했습니다. 특히 2024년에는 한경 미디어그룹 전체 페이지뷰(PV) 1위를 기록하며 '2024 한국경제 디지털 대상'을 수상했습니다. items.t: Is bad news for Jensen Huang also bad news for the AI industry?
items.d: "Jensen is Nvidia, right? And so much of this economy is riding on Nvidia."
items.fullText: We didn’t see this coming. Or at least, I didn’t — a week ago, when I wrote about Nvidia’s board opening an investigation into then-CEO Jensen Huang, I assumed his job was safe. On the latest episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast , Rebecca Bellan, Tim De Chant, and I discussed how Huang’s ouster went down and what it means for the larger AI economy. While Tim said he saw it coming (albeit not this quickly), Rebecca said, “I didn’t think it was going to happen at all.” Listen on Apple Podcasts Listen on Spotify “Jensen is Nvidia, right?” she added. “And so much of this economy is riding on Nvidia.” Similarly, I marveled at how quickly Huang’s support seemed to crumble, with more scandals seeming to emerge every day. (At the same time, there are many who’d still like to see him return .) And we also took a moment to wonder what will happen to Nvidia’s investments in the larger AI ecosystem. Keep reading for a preview of our conversation, edited for length and clarity; you can listen to the whole episode here . Tim De Chant: I figured this was coming. I didnt think it would happen this quickly. I thought there would be at least a few days. Rebecca Bellan: I didnt think it was going to happen at all. I mean, Jensen is Nvidia, right? And so much of this economy is riding on Nvidia. And we’ve got nothing but the last few years of data to show us that billionaires can do whatever the hell they want. So it was surprising to me — it almost restored my faith in humanity, that he resigned. But someone said to me, If this were Elon, nothing would happen.” He would not be resigning. Nothing would be going down Anthony Ha: Which is interesting, because I would have said, as of a week ago, or even just a few days ago, that Jensen is in the same category as Elon. I mean, no one is quite as special as Elon is, but it’s a big, incredibly successful company. Like you said — in a lot of ways, the entire AI economy is built on top of Nvidia. And for most people, Jensen Huang is Nvidia. Hes the biggest shareholder. He has family members who work at the company, and probably most importantly, there was no succession plan in place. So this was not something that they were prepared for at all. Rebecca: I think we should actually take a step back, because we just launched into this conversation assuming — rightly so — that our listeners will know what the heck were talking about. But for those who somehow dont, Jensen resigned on Thursday, after it came out he was having an affair with a former executive at an Nvidia customer called Megaspeed, whos alleged to have ties to Chinese intelligence. And then there was another reported affair with an Nvidia executive. So hes resigned. Nvidia CFO Collette Kress is jumping in as the interim CEO. Shes a longtime board member. I think its always interesting when a CFO steps in to be a CEO. It just means we’re going to manage expenses right now, like thats the key. items.t: Where was Nvidia’s security team?
items.d: Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August, and now that CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down over his relationships, including one with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China, a former intelligence officer says it’s the kind of leak that runs everyday conversations, which most corporate security teams are poorly equipped to catch.
items.fullText: Outsiders had little reason to notice when Nvidia’s longtime chief security officer and head of product security stepped down in August. Just two and a half months later, CEO Jensen Huang himself left the company over growing questions about his extramarital relationships — starting with an executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore data center company that U.S. investigators suspect of funneling Nvidia chips to China, then widening to reports about two separate affairs with Nvidia employees. At the time, David Reber, who spent four years as CSO and seven at Nvidia overall, said he was leaving for health reasons. “This wasn’t a pivot I had planned. But I know what needs to come first: family and health,” he wrote on LinkedIn in late August, disclosing that he’d been diagnosed with young-onset Parkinson’s more than two years ago. Reber’s replacement, Saša Zdjelar, previously spent 17 years at ExxonMobil in Houston, leaving as a senior IT manager before spending one year at Salesforce and several years at the cybersecurity company ReversingLabs. Zdjelar didnt respond to questions Thursday about the transition or what the security team knew. Nothing public connects Reber’s or Zdjelar’s role changes to the Megaspeed matter, but it seems fair to wonder what Nvidias security team knew about the government’s scrutiny of Megaspeed and about Huang’s relationships, and whether anyone raised concerns. Reber didnt respond to questions Thursday. Nvidia also has not answered our related questions. Relationships between a CEO and his employees typically fall to HR, legal and the board, not security. But security specialists say any affair even one inside the office can give a foreign intelligence service leverage over an exec who wants it kept quiet. Still, spotting the clues isnt easy. The way intelligence services collect information, much of it through everyday conversation rather than hacking, makes it especially difficult for security teams to identify risks, according to retired senior intelligence officer Nicholas Eftimiades, who says he has trained more than 1,000 corporate security professionals. Some people inside Nvidia clearly knew parts of the picture. Nvidia’s top lawyer was engaged with the government’s Megaspeed inquiry more than a year ago, The New York Times reported earlier this week . (Nvidia has said it regularly contacts officials.) Reports about Huang’s relationships with employees suggest colleagues also knew of them, even if the behavior is not expressly forbidden by Nvidias code of conduct . The Times cited five Nvidia employees who said he was involved with a vice president who reported directly to him; Reuters, citing two people, later reported a second relationship. What’s unclear is whether any of that reached security. Even if it had, Eftimiades, who wrote Chinese Espionage Operations and Tactics in 2020, told TechCrunch that a security team’s resources are often limited. items.t: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
items.d: The petition had attracted more than 115,000 signatures as of Saturday afternoon.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 1:41 PM PST · November 14, 2026 Image Credits: Li Hongbo/VCG / Getty Images Anthony Ha Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang A petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate the company’s recently ousted CEO Jensen Huang appears to have attracted more than 115,000 signatures as of Saturday afternoon. The petition website said the signers include 5,965 current Nvidia employees, 1,108 former employees, and 63,063 shareholders. Notable supporters include Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, Replit CEO Amjad Masad, Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, and Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan. The petition states that its signers are “concerned that Jensen was removed without meaningful due process” and demands that the board “bring him back while an independent investigation establishes the facts.” It also calls on the board to ensure a fair investigation and provide more information to the public. “Jensen deserves due process, not mob justice,” the petition says. Huang resigned on Thursday , four days after confessing to having an affair with a chip executive suspected by U.S. intelligence to be a Chinese spy. The former CEO has agreed to testify before Congress, while news reports have also suggested that Huang engaged in multiple extramarital affairs . Nvidia appointed CFO Colette Kress as the company’s interim CEO while it searches for a permanent replacement. Nvidia’s stock price fell sharply through the week, while Huang’s departure is also expected to leave a big gap in AI industry funding . items.t: Howard Lutnick will testify as bipartisan pressure grows over Nvidia scandal
items.d: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who was also requested to testify, had previously praised the commerce secretary for his support and involvement in the industry.
items.fullText: Congress Howard Lutnick agrees to testify as bipartisan pressure grows over Nvidia scandal Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who was also requested to testify, had previously praised the commerce secretary for his support and involvement in the industry. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Commerce Secretary Lutnick agrees to testify about Nvidia 03:06 Get more news Live on Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 12, 2026, 9:45 PM EST By Kyla Guilfoil Facing bipartisan pressure, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick agreed Thursday to testify before Congress over national security concerns regarding the expanding Nvidia scandal. The announcement comes after Sen. Tim Scott, R-S.C., chair of the Senate Banking Committee, sent letters Thursday to Lutnick and Jensen Huang, who resigned as Nvidia’s CEO earlier in the day after reports that he had an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. “Secretary Lutnick has proactively agreed to appear voluntarily before the Banking Committee to address their questions,” Kristen Eichamer, a spokesperson for Lutnick, told NBC News. In the letters, Scott asked that Huang and Lutnick voluntarily appear before the Senate Banking Committee to testify Dec. 3 and Dec. 10, respectively. Scott requested that Lutnick testify “for a public hearing regarding recent public reports about Nvidia and the Department of Commerce’s role that raises national security concerns.” “Given the Department of Commerce’s central role in issuing and enforcing export control regulations, your testimony before the Committee will be essential in our oversight of these efforts,” Scott wrote. Representatives for Huang did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Scott’s letter. Jensen Huang resigned Thursday as CEO of Nvidia. Kiyoshi Ota / Bloomberg via Getty Earlier Thursday, Sen. Richard Blumenthal, D-Conn., told reporters that Lutnick should appear voluntarily, though if he doesn’t, “he may need to be subpoenaed.” Blumenthal said one thing he wants to know is, “were export controls relaxed?” Sen. Jim Banks, R-Ind., said in an interview with Fox News that he’d like Lutnick to testify before Congress “ASAP,” noting concerns about chips being exported that should not have. items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after affair with suspected Chinese spy Huang resigned after it was reported that he had a relationship with Alice Huang, a businesswoman who is accused of being a Chinese agent, and also engaged in a relationship with an Nvidia executive. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 The rise and fall of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang 03:09 Get more news Live on Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 12, 2026, 8:53 AM EST / Updated Nov. 12, 2026, 9:21 PM EST By Rob Wile , Steve Kopack and Brian Cheung Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned following reports that he had multiple extramarital relationships, including one with a suspected agent of China and another with an executive who reported to him — a stunning turn of events for the head of a company at the heart of the global AI investment boom. Colette Kress, the company’s chief financial officer, will become interim CEO, Nvidia’s board said in a statement. Nvidia shares plunged more as much as 16% after the board’s announcement, before later recovering and closing lower by 4.3%. A company spokesperson clarified that Huang will not be working with Nvidia in any capacity going forward. The company also named its first chairman. That role will be filled by Harvey Jones, who is a former CEO of major chip company Synopsys. The addition of a chairman is a major governance overhaul at a company that for decades relied solely on Huang. Nvidia’s board met Wednesday night to address Huang’s future at the company, a source familiar with the matter told NBC News, adding that the White House was aware of the meeting. Huang, 63, co-founded Nvidia in the early 1990s and led the company’s meteoric rise amid the AI boom of the past several years. Jensen Huang at the annual Nvidia GTC conference in San Jose, Calif., in 2025. Justin Sullivan / Getty “I believe deeply in this company and in its future,” Kress wrote in her first email to Nvidia employees as interim CEO. “The Board, Estaff and I recognize that this has been an extraordinarily difficult period and I want you to know how grateful we are for your resilience, professionalism and continued dedication. items.d: Questions are growing about Jensen Huang’s ability to hang on as CEO of Nvidia after the New York Times reported he had an extramarital relationship with an executive at the company who reported to him. NBC News’ Hallie Jackson reports.

items.d: Nvidia has named Joon Kim, a former acting U.S. Attorney, to head the investigation into CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with a woman U.S. intelligence agencies believe to be a Chinese spy. NBC News’ Brian Cheung reports.
